w: Swamishri left Vidyanagar at 6.15 p.m. Swamishri then left for Bochasan, arriving at the mandir at 7.53 p.m.

At 10.30 a.m., Pujya Viveksagar Swami spoke on the occasion of Kishore Day. The kishores performed a traditional dance and a seminar was presented by kishores of Tajpur on "The Necessity of Mandirs." Thereafter the kishores of Botad performed a drama on 'Vajesinh Darbar's Hookah.' Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly.
Living with Swamishri
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of the canvas murtis of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj and Shri Radha Krishna Dev for a BAPS kutir mandir in Cheri village of Valsad district.
At 9.45 a.m. Swamishri gave diskha to 57 youths, out of which 18 youths were given parshad diksha and 39 parshads were given the bhagwati diksha.

At 6.30 p.m., the Shri Hari Jayanti celebration commenced with dhun and prayers. Thereafter Brahmadarshan Swami spoke about the purpose of Bhagwan Swaminarayan's birth. The story of Joban Pagi's transformation was enacted. Atmatrupt Swami spoke about the socio-spiritual activities performed by Bhagwan Swaminarayan. A drama on Devji Bhagat's faith in Shriji Maharaj was performed. BAPS youths of Vadodara performed a beautiful traditional folk dance. Ishwarcharan Swami elaborated upon the divine nature of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. This was followed by another drama 'Bhaktavtsal Shri Hari' by youths. A speech on the impact of Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Parampara was delivered by Viveksagar Swami. Thereafter the senior sadhus honored Swamishri with a variety of garlands. A traditional dance "Chaitra sud navami avi..." was performed by BAPS youths of Nadiad. In conclusion Swamishri blessed the assembly, "Bhagwan Swaminarayan came on this earth to redeem countless people. Today it is also the birth of Bhagwan Shri Ram. We have been blessed with the two celebrations so that we may attain Ram Rajya and Akshardham. We need Ram Rajya in our country. If we attain Ram Rajya, that is, the way in which Ram ruled our country, then there will be peace in India. And if we worship Bhagwan Swaminarayan then we will attain Akshardham and therefore eternal happiness... Bhagwan Swaminarayan gifted the Shikshapatri for the benefit of all mankind, regardless of distinction of color or religion." At 10.20 p.m. Swamishri performed the Shri Hari Jayanti celebration arti and then rocked Shri Harikrishna Maharaj in a decorated swing.

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
28 March 2004, Nadiad

BAPS youths of Nadiad performed a total of 178,512 rosaries, 54,102 prostrations, 165,211 circumambulations and 84 waterless fasts for Swamishri's good health. They had started these austerities from 1 December 2003. Similarly devotees of Nadiad had performed a total 1,492,469 rosaries, 154,795 prostrations, 165,886 circumambulations, 138 waterless fasts and inspired 110 aspirants into Satsang assembly.
Today being Sunday, after his morning puja Swamishri himself expressed a wish to give blessings.

Swamishri said, "Today the Sunday assembly will be held here, because it is Jogi Maharaj's command. The devotees of Botad come here especially for this benefit. Everyone is enthusiastic and eager, and they even come on foot. When there is understanding of greatness, devotion happens.

Vyasji was mighty; he composed seventeen Puranas. The Varaha Purana, Kurma Purana, Narasimha Purana, Devi Purana, he wrote all these Puranas, and yet he found no peace. Then Vyasji told Naradji about his restlessness. Naradji then spoke firmly about worship of the manifest God.

Worship of the soul and of God, knowledge of the true form of the soul and of God, that is true happiness. If the true form of God, of the Sant and of Brahman is properly understood, there is peace. But Vyasji had spoken of all this indirectly. One who has not sung the glory of the manifest God, through whom liberation comes, has no peace.

Peace lies only in singing and hearing the divine actions of God and of God's devotees. Their discourse alone, their kirtan alone, talk of them alone is what we must do. Bhagatji had such understanding of Gunatitanand Swami's greatness that 'this one sitting is Akshar, this one lying down is Akshar', and so he was filled with joy. Bhakta Chintamani, Harililamrut and Satsangijivan contain the divine actions of God and His devotees; read them and there will be peace.

But even after meeting God, and a Sant like God, why is there restlessness? The reason is attachment to the five senses' pleasures. As long as there is attachment to eating and drinking, luxuries, bungalows and so on, however much is said, it does not go inside. If we are sitting here while the discourse goes on but other thoughts run inside, how can there be peace!

Not living by the commands brings restlessness. But if we live by the commands, there is happiness and peace in every way. Enjoy the five senses in relation to God and there is happiness; enjoy them in relation to the world and there is misery. Do darshan of God with your eyes and hear God's discourse with your ears, and there will be peace. Let us pray to Maharaj that everyone gets such knowledge, such understanding and such happiness. We have received the happiness of God and the Sant, and Shastriji Maharaj has given the knowledge of Akshar Purushottam; may it become firm in our lives and may we be happy in it. These are my blessings."

Prior to his morning puja Swamishri performed the 29th patotsav arti and pushpanjali of Yagnapurush Smruti Mandir. An annakut was offered to the murti of Shastriji Maharaj. After his morning puja Swamishri blessed the assembly. Today, more than 3,500 devotees had pilgrimaged by foot to Sarangpur from various neighbouring towns and villages.

ds.t: Give him prasad before he leaves
w: When Swamishri went up to the mandir for darshan of Thakorji, he must have seen Ghanshyambhai, originally from Bhaili and living in Secunderabad. After that Swamishri did his puja and then came to his residence. Before the meal plate arrived, Swamishri called a sadhu and said, "That man from Bhaili has come, hasn't he! If he is leaving, give him prasad."
All his life Swamishri has looked after the devotees. The thread of his glance keeps the devotees' hearts bound to him.
During the meal Gnananand Swami sang Sanskrit shlokas he had composed himself. As he sang he said, "My tune is not good, but I am singing anyway."
Swamishri said, "The feeling is good!"
In 'Sakhi! uparna range rache nahi...' (Friend, he is not pleased by outward colour), Nishkulanand Swami describes the natural way of Shri Hari. The same is seen in Swamishri too.

In a conversation today Swamishri said, "Earlier we could reach everywhere. As long as the body was well, I never said no to anyone. If we set out and two villages came on the way, we would do those too, because in those days the body was good, the hands and feet worked and health was good, and if we travelled the devotees were happy. Now it is one meeting in the morning and then the whole day working sitting inside. Once in, we are in; we come out only the next morning."

Swamishri, who all his life travelled from village to village to uplift devotees and serve people, now travels less because of age and health at the doctors' insistence, yet his enthusiasm is still just as fresh!

ds.t: Walking all the way from Surat
w: As the devotees' walking pilgrimages and austerities came up, Swamishri said, "Many people come on foot."
Narayancharan Swami said, "There is only one reason, that your health stays good."
Laughing, Yogicharan Swami said, "Everyone has sponsored your health."
Swamishri said, "That is fine, but if they walk from far away they get tired!"
A sadhu said, "Just now a young man walked all alone from Surat."
Hearing this, Swamishri turned his hand in a gesture of wonder and said, "Walking pilgrimages have gone on since Maharaj's time. Groups used to come before too."
In this way Swamishri accepted the devotees' feelings.
